Official OSU campus-map Buildings layer filtered to Geography=Columbus Contiguous, plus official Parking polygons within 250 m of that contiguous-building union after excluding explicit off-campus / Indianola school lots; dissolved and morphology-closed at 120 m to recover the mapped east-campus, medical, athletics, west-campus, Waterman, and adjacent public-property edge structure described in the OSU framework and campus map, then limited to resulting components of at least 1 acre to drop tiny support slivers and the stray 17th-Avenue satellite remnant. REWEIGHTED (Stage 2 fork ruling 4, Stage 4/5 batch): weight = LandScan USA 2021 DAYTIME population (residents+workers+students+shoppers) attributed to the footprint's area inside each block group, i.e. the block group's LandScan day population times the footprint's share of that block group's 2020 TIGER land area. This replaces the pure land-area basis, which gave 47.5% of OSUPD's mass to block group 390490011221 (LandScan day 17,867) and 10.0% to 390490011212 (LandScan day 37,537). Block-group pieces with zero modelled daytime population get no weight, so athletics, parking and west-campus acreage is not paid for being large. LIMITATION: the OSU footprint polygon is not stored in this repo, so LandScan is applied at block-group resolution under a uniform-density assumption inside the block group rather than summed over raster cells inside (polygon x block group) as for Harvard.
